parts.desc: 根据 HTTP 方法和路径，把请求交给对应处理函数
parts.desc_en: The HTTP method and path route the request to the matching handler

parts.desc: 在业务代码前后统一完成日志、身份、校验或错误转换
parts.desc_en: Complete log, identity, verification or error conversion uniformly before and after the business code

parts.desc: 执行这条端点自己的业务规则，并返回明确响应
parts.desc_en: Execute this endpoint's own business rules and return an explicit response

variants.when: 页面和后端放在一个项目里
variants.when_en: Keep frontend and backend in one project.
Build a small set of explicit endpoints.

variants.when: 模块和规则较多的团队项目
variants.when_en: For larger projects with more conventions.

use.t: 优先使用项目已经选好的框架，遵循现有目录和写法
小项目选简单方案；团队大、规则多时再考虑更强约束
先读官方最小示例：一条 GET、一条 POST、一种错误处理
让 AI 说明代码放在哪个文件、由谁调用、如何验证

dont.t: 把框架名字当能力：换框架不会自动解决业务设计问题
一个项目同时混用多个后端框架，路由和配置各管一套
不看版本就复制旧教程：配置和 API 很可能已经变化
只会运行模板却不理解请求入口、处理过程和响应出口，排错时会缺少判断依据

lessonPractice.title: 项目已经使用 Next.js Route Handler，现在要增加一条注册接口。怎样处理更合适？

options.label: 沿用现有路由、校验和错误处理方式，把注册业务放进对应处理函数并验证成功与失败请求
options.feedback: 对。框架负责统一入口和公共处理，新增业务应沿用项目已有结构，并用真实请求验证结果。

options.label: 另外安装 Express 专门处理注册接口，让两套框架分别维护自己的路由和错误格式
options.feedback: 同一项目并行维护两套路由和错误处理会增加排错成本，这个需求没有证明需要第二套框架。

options.label: 复制框架示例并返回固定成功结果，等页面完成后再补输入校验和注册业务
options.feedback: 固定成功结果不能证明注册发生，也会让前端把未完成的业务误认为可用。

en.title: A project already uses Next.js Route Handlers and now needs a sign-up endpoint. What is the better approach?

options.label: Follow the existing routing, validation, and error patterns, put sign-up logic in the matching handler, and verify success and failure requests
options.feedback: Correct. The framework supplies consistent entry and shared handling; new business logic should follow that structure and be verified with real requests.

options.label: Install Express just for sign-up so two frameworks can maintain separate routes and error formats
options.feedback: Maintaining two routing and error systems increases debugging cost, and this request does not justify a second framework.

options.label: Copy a framework example that always returns success, then add validation and sign-up logic after the page is finished
options.feedback: A fixed success response does not prove an account was created and makes unfinished business logic appear usable.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 先检查项目已经使用的后端框架和目录约定，不要再引入另一套框架。沿用现有写法新增 `POST /api/signup`：接收邮箱和密码，校验输入后调用注册业务，成功返回新账号，失败返回明确原因。完成后分别发送一条有效请求和一条缺少邮箱的请求，确认状态码、响应内容和服务端日志都符合预期，并告诉我改了哪些文件。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the backend framework and directory conventions already used by this project; do not introduce a second framework. Follow the existing pattern to add `POST /api/signup`: accept email and password, validate the input, call the sign-up logic, return the new account on success, and return a clear reason on failure. Then send one valid request and one request without an email, verify the status codes, response bodies, and server logs, and list the files you changed.

use.t: Give a team a common project structure

dont.t: Adopt a large framework for one tiny function without need
Mix several frameworks in the same service casually
Put business rules inside framework-specific glue everywhere
Assume framework defaults match every security requirement
